title: Syntactic Segmentation and Collage Generation for Videogame Levels with Perceptual Distance
abstract: arXiv:2610.38987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In procedural videogame level design, many existing techniques combine hand-authored level chunks. Some existing analysis techniques also rely on a higher-level graph structure which abstracts the level design. In this paper, we explore techniques for computing both of these things automatically from an existing design. We introduce the concept of perceptual distance, based on analysis techniques from the architecture subfield of Space Syntax. We use this perceptual distance to segment level designs with hierarchical clustering. We compare with past work on StarCraft analysis, show results on rooms from Super Metroid, and also demonstrate a proof-of-concept level generation algorithm based on this segmentation method.

translated_title: 基于感知距离的电子游戏关卡句法分割与拼贴生成
translated_abstract: 在程序化电子游戏关卡设计中，许多现有技术会组合手工制作的关卡片段。一些现有的分析技术也依赖于对关卡设计进行抽象的更高级别图结构。在本文中，我们探索了从现有设计中自动计算这两者的技术。我们引入了感知距离的概念，该概念基于建筑学子领域空间句法中的分析技术。我们使用这种感知距离，通过层次聚类来分割关卡设计。我们将其与以往在《星际争霸》分析方面的工作进行比较，展示了在《超级银河战士》房间上的结果，并且还演示了基于这种分割方法的概念验证关卡生成算法。
tldr: 本文提出基于建筑学空间句法理论的“感知距离”概念，结合层次聚类实现游戏关卡的自动句法分割，并据此构建了概念验证的关卡拼贴生成算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of perceptual distance based on Space Syntax from architecture, uses it with hierarchical clustering to automatically segment videogame levels, and demonstrates a proof-of-concept collage-based level generation algorithm.
